_schema.description: 2026 offensive infrastructure context used by the draft-room Team Changes view. Play-caller history is descriptive, not a projection, and first-time callers are treated as uncertainty rather than automatically bad.
_schema.newCallerRank: CBS Fantasy rank among the 18 new 2026 play-callers; lower is more favorable for 2026 fantasy outlook. Omitted for returning play-callers.

ARI.historyNote: Experienced Shanahan/McVay-tree coach. His prior Jets play-calling stint was poor, while CBS grades Arizona's current play-caller slot around average; 2026 fantasy change outlook ranks 4th among new callers.

ATL.historyNote: Called nine Browns games in 2025 plus Notre Dame/Alabama. Cleveland finished near the bottom in scoring and total offense, though personnel and QB instability were major confounders.

BAL.historyNote: First NFL play-calling season. CBS gives first-time callers an average baseline rather than assuming they are poor; fantasy change outlook ranks 6th among the 18 new callers.

BUF.historyNote: Joe Brady remains the play-caller despite the OC title changing. CBS gives Brady a 4/5 play-caller grade.

CAR.historyNote: First NFL play-calling season after serving as Carolina's OC without calling plays. Scheme continuity reduces change risk, but CBS ranks the fantasy change 18th of 18 new callers.

CHI.historyNote: CBS places Johnson among the small handful of elite offensive minds/play-callers.

CIN.historyNote: Established caller; CBS grades Taylor 3.5/5 in its 2026 infrastructure model.

CLE.historyNote: CBS calls Monken a very good play-caller and gives him a 4/5 grade; 2026 fantasy change outlook ranks 9th among new callers.

DAL.historyNote: Returning play-caller; CBS describes his 2026 play-caller grade as above average.

DEN.historyNote: First NFL play-calling season. Sean Payton handed play-calling to Webb; CBS treats first-time callers as average until they establish a record.

DET.historyNote: CBS gives Petzing an above-average play-caller grade and ranks Detroit's change 2nd among the 18 new 2026 callers.

GB.historyNote: Established caller; CBS rates Green Bay's play-calling advantage above Kellen Moore's in its infrastructure comparison.

HOU.historyNote: Returning caller; CBS explicitly describes Caley as above average.

IND.historyNote: Returning caller; CBS identifies play-calling as an advantage for Indianapolis.

JAC.historyNote: CBS says Coen has established himself as one of the NFL's best play-callers.

KC.historyNote: Reid remains the play-caller despite the OC change. CBS grades him 4.5/5, noting a modest downgrade from prior 5/5 seasons after recent offensive regression.

LAC.historyNote: CBS grades McDaniel 4.5/5 and ranks the Chargers' change No. 1 among the 18 new 2026 play-callers for fantasy.

LAR.historyNote: CBS places McVay among the league's elite offensive minds and top play-callers.

LV.historyNote: CBS calls Kubiak a very good play-caller after Seattle's highly efficient 2025 offense; 2026 fantasy change ranks 3rd among new callers.

MIA.historyNote: Previously called Houston's offense in 2023-24. CBS expects a run-heavy West Coast approach in Miami and ranks the fantasy change 15th among new callers.

MIN.historyNote: Returning caller; CBS gives O'Connell a 4/5 play-caller grade.

NE.historyNote: Returning experienced caller; CBS cites New England's play-caller advantage as a strength in its infrastructure ranking.

NO.historyNote: Returning caller with substantial experience. CBS rates him below Matt LaFleur but still within an above-average offensive environment.

NYG.historyNote: CBS explicitly rates Nagy as a below-average play-caller; 2026 fantasy change ranks 13th among the new callers.

NYJ.historyNote: CBS gives Reich a below-average grade and says it was even lower than Nagy's because of his previous two NFL stops.

PHI.historyNote: First NFL play-calling season. CBS gives first-time callers an average baseline; fantasy change outlook ranks 5th among the 18 new callers.

PIT.historyNote: CBS gives McCarthy a slightly above-average play-caller grade; fantasy change ranks 12th among new callers.

SEA.historyNote: First NFL play-calling season after Klint Kubiak's departure. CBS gives first-time callers an average baseline and ranks this change 11th among new callers.

SF.historyNote: CBS calls Shanahan one of the NFL's best play-callers.

TB.historyNote: Two seasons of Falcons play-calling showed adaptable personnel usage but mixed results. CBS ranks Tampa's 2026 fantasy change 14th among new callers.

TEN.historyNote: CBS grades Daboll around average as a play-caller, an upgrade over Tennessee's prior situation; fantasy change ranks 8th among new callers.

WAS.historyNote: First NFL play-calling season. CBS assigns first-time callers a neutral 3/5 baseline; fantasy change ranks 10th among new callers.
